newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Aracruz Celulose invests $45 mln in sawmill.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Aracruz Celulose invests $45 mln in sawmill.

text.p: Brazilian pulp and paper manufacturer Aracruz Celulose SA is investing $45 million in a sawmill joint venture with an undisclosed U.S. company, the president of Aracruz said.

Luiz Kaufmann said Aracruz was looking to diversify its business within the timber industry and would invest $45 million over the next two years to build a sawmill in the northeastern Brazilian state of Bahia, where one third of the company's forested area is located.

"This is a tiny investment for a company like Aracruz, but it signals a step in a new direction," he said. "There is enormous potential for growth in this area and the company plans to invest further in this sector in the future."
The sawmill is being built in a joint venture with a U.S. company and Aracruz will retain a controlling stake, Kaufmann said.
The sawmill is due to come online in 1999 and produce 75,000 cubic meters of sawn timber annually with 50 percent of output destined for export.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
